title: Tooltip
description: A short label that appears beside an element on hover or keyboard focus, such as naming an icon button; announced as the trigger's description.

components.Tooltip: Groups a trigger with the short hint shown when the user hovers or focuses it.
components.TooltipContent: Holds the short hint the tooltip shows.
components.TooltipProvider: Shares timing settings between all tooltips inside it.
components.TooltipTrigger: Marks the element that shows the tooltip on hover or focus.
